messages:
kyle_sales: Prospect MeridianCare requested a 10-day POC for their finetuned 'meridian-70b-ft' model. Needs: catalog onboarding, tokenizer check, KV/cache behavior for ~2k token sessions, and a pricing estimate for ~120k tokens/day. Also asked about customer-managed KMS and SOC2 docs. Link: https://meridian.example/packet

anya_se: @mohit_eng can you run tokenizer parity + adapter compatibility? main risks: custom special tokens + LoRA adapters. If tokenizer differs we must bundle it. Also confirm if hosted supports their CMK request or Private required.

mohit_eng: Quick scan: adapters look standard, tokenizer.json adds 3 special tokens. We'll need the bundle or mapping. They supplied q8 quant artifacts — ok for hosted. q4 would need kernel rollout. I can spin a short perf test on Dedicated for q8 today.

elaine_sec: MeridianCare requires CMK+per-request logs and SOC2 report. They prefer Dedicated in us-west with VPC peering. I'll send our security intake and KMS integration template.

rico_acct: Pricing ballpark for 120k/day (~3.6M/mo): Hosted estimate ~ $0.009 gen + $0.0009 ctx => ~ $32k/mo. Dedicated reserved ~ $11k/mo base + infra. Final depends on concurrency/batch. @kyle_sales pls confirm expected concurrency.

infra-bot: Created ticket SALES-20451 "MeridianCare POC - meridian-70b-ft onboarding & KMS" assigned to anya_se, mohit_eng, elaine_sec, rico_acct.
